@Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation.isUnit_jacobian_of_linearIndependent_of_span_eq_top : ∀ {R : Type u_3} {S : Type u_4}
  {ι : Type u_2} {σ : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : CommRing S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S]
  (P : Algebra.PreSubmersivePresentation R S ι σ) [inst_3 : Finite σ],
  (LinearIndependent S fun j i ↦ (MvPolynomial.aeval P.val) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (P.map i)) (P.relation j))) →
    Submodule.span S (Set.range fun j i ↦ (MvPolynomial.aeval P.val) ((MvPolynomial.pderiv (P.map i)) (P.relation j))) =
        ⊤ →
      IsUnit P.jacobian
